title: Lambda Expressions and Capture Safety
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of Lambda Expressions and Capture Safety.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: A lambda is an unnamed callable object. Captures copy by value or refer to variables by reference. A reference capture is unsafe if the captured object expires before the lambda is used.
understand.whyItMatters: Lambdas enable concise callbacks and algorithms; capture lifetime and mutation must be deliberate.
understand.explain: Keep captures minimal and explicit. Value capture is often safer for callbacks that outlive local scope; reference captures require lifetime guarantees.
